vulnerability_name: Unitronics Vision PLC and HMI Insecure Default Password Vulnerability
required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
nvd_description: Unitronics VisiLogic before version 9.9.00, used in Vision and Samba PLCs and HMIs, uses a default administrative password. An unauthenticated attacker with network access can take administrative control of a vulnerable system.
narrative: A new CISA KEV advisory has dropped for Unitronics Vision PLCs. Exploitation allows unauthenticated remote adversaries to bypass authorization and overwrite setpoints on pump logic.
